content: Standard axios 401-refresh pattern: response interceptor on 401 calls POST /auth/refresh once, retries the original request once, single-flights concurrent 401s behind one shared refresh promise to avoid refresh stampedes, clears auth state and redirects to /login only if refresh itself fails. In-repo CONCERNS.md confirms frontend/src/services/api.js has no interceptor at all today. External search unavailable — general pattern knowledge.
